matches.reason: It writes webinar invites and reminders, so recaps could be a natural addition.

bullets.label: Closest match
bullets.text: Webinar Invite Writer covers invites and reminders. Recaps would be a small addition to the same tool, with the same owner.

bullets.label: Worth asking
bullets.text: Should recaps go to everyone who registered, or only to people who attended?

approve.reason: Approved. Recap emails use only public webinar content, and a person sends them. We'd suggest adding this to Webinar Invite Writer so invites, reminders and recaps live in one place.
approve.what_would_change: If you want recaps to include attendee questions or names, ask again, since that would use customer details.
